Sam (docs): Opened PR #1314 — migration guide tweaks + SDK snippets cleanup. Need: terminology sweep, JS snippet validation, and CI linkcheck pass.
Priya: I can do the terminology and tone pass. Quick rule: use 'model variant' consistently and prefer 'serving' in user guides.
Liam (eng): I can sanity-check the JS snippet. Please make it runnable with minimal placeholders.
Sam (docs): Snippets use REDWOOD_API_KEY and the v2 constructor pattern. Also fixed a couple inline links.
ci-checker: docs-lint: warning: passive voice on migration.md:45. linkcheck: 1 broken external URL (old-host).
render-bot: Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-1314--docs.redwood.ai/ (partial render, linkcheck failing)
Priya: I'll replace passive constructions and change phrases like "we deprecated" to "X is deprecated in v2". Also limit jargon on first mention (add parenthetical).
Liam (eng): Ran the Node example locally after updating import path to @redwood/inference-js. Works. Suggest keeping async/await only.
Sam (docs): Good. I'm trimming examples to under 8 lines and changing comments to use // NOTE:. Also switching 'prompt' to 'input' in examples for consistency.
ci-checker: mkdocs-render: queued
Priya: Small tone nit: change "you may want to" to "run the following". Be direct.
Liam (eng): I'll approve once mkdocs-render passes.
render-bot: mkdocs-render: success. Preview: https://deploy-preview-1314--docs.redwood.ai/ (all checks green)
Sam (docs): Planning to merge on Monday 10:00 PT during docs merge window. Will request approvals now.
Priya: Approved pending merge window.
Liam (eng): Approved.
Sam (docs): Merged Monday 10:05 PT. Will open a backport for the 2.1 branch with the link fix. Thanks all.
